firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Sharing the code and data behind our paper-track writeup, as rule 3.6b asks:
https://github.com/muhandalsaiari/araswe-sandbox/tree/araswe

It has the pre-registration, task lists, agent configs, run ledger, verdict files,
agent traces and analysis scripts. Licence: Apache-2.0.

Translations are released as translated prose with the code parts replaced by
placeholders. release_translations.py puts the code back from the competition's
own tasks.jsonl. The issue text is removed from the traces.
